title: AI Risk Management Framework - Engage | NIST

policy_extraction.issuing_body: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)

evidence.quote: NIST has developed the voluntary AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF) through a consensus-driven, open, transparent, and collaborative process.
NIST has developed the voluntary AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF)

policy_extraction.implementation_notes: The AI RMF 1.0 was released on January 26, 2023 following a consensus-driven, open, and collaborative process. A companion AI RMF Playbook, AI RMF Roadmap, and AI RMF Crosswalks are also available. NIST plans to revise the Framework after the community gains several years of experience and additional research is conducted.

risk_framing.rationale_summary: The document describes NIST's process for developing a voluntary AI Risk Management Framework through broad stakeholder engagement. The governance rationale centers on managing AI risks to users and society broadly, consistent with a consumer/public safety framing. Secondary frames include innovation enablement (voluntary, collaborative framework) and social stability (civil society inclusion, bias workshops).
